title: Brand configuration
description: Product name, colours, icons, identifiers and hosts. Renaming the product means editing this file, running pnpm brand:gen and rebuilding; no product name is hard-coded in app or package code.

colors.description: Colours of the browser and the installed app around the page. They repeat UI tokens of apps/web/src/ui/tokens.css (theme = --color-sky-top, background = --color-sky-mid); a test keeps them equal.

theme.description: Browser toolbar and installed-app title bar (manifest theme_color).

background.description: Splash behind the installed app while it loads (manifest background_color).

icon.description: The logo (assets/ manifest path, made by pnpm assets:logo): the largest of the rounded-safe icons; the favicon, Apple touch and other sizes sit beside it (packages/brand/src/icons.ts).

iconMaskable.description: Full-bleed logo whose artwork stays inside the maskable safe zone: the manifest's maskable icon.

appIds.description: Bundle ids of the native shells (Capacitor iOS/Android, Tauri desktop). Changing one makes a different app for the stores.

urlScheme.description: Private-use URI scheme (RFC 8252) of the native shells: deep links and, once sign-in moves to the shared IdP, the native OIDC redirect.

primaryTenant.description: The tenant the product is served for and the IdP issuer it will sign in with (not wired yet: parents sign in with Google through the game server).

hostTemplates.description: Hosts of one tenant; {domain} is the tenant's domain.
